answer.reasons: This is a clean, centred black-and-gold board. It has a clear kicker, a category title, a gold rule and four nominee rows with even spacing and padding. The text is easy to read over the dark stage, the bright plate and the busy plate, because the panel is opaque. The only weak spot is how quiet the suspense step looks, and that does not stop it going on air.

answer.reasons: This is a clean, centred black-and-gold board. It has an opaque panel and a double gold frame, and the four nominee rows get equal space. Every text sits on a solid dark ground, so it stays readable over the light, busy and video backgrounds. The long category name and long director names fit inside their fields without clipping, as the native-pixel crops confirm. The empty state shows only the category over its rule. Suspense and Reveal are both offered and both work: the winner's row turns into a gold bar with dark, readable text, and the other rows are dimmed but still legible. The Take, the category Update and Out all animate cleanly, with no text collisions. It airs as delivered; the only nits are a subtle suspense state and a reveal with no label.
